tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in Parikshaa user's id, email, and profile summary. Use this to confirm the MCP connection is authenticated.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List my folders
tools.description: List the signed-in Parikshaa user's custom folders (name, description, color, timestamps). Scoped by RLS to the current user.

tools.name: list_folder_items
tools.title: List folder items
tools.description: Items saved inside a specific folder owned by the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_quiz_attempts
tools.title: List quiz attempts
tools.description: Recent quiz results for the signed-in user (score, topic, timestamps).

tools.name: get_progress_stats
tools.title: Get progress stats
tools.description: Total XP, level, and recent XP transactions for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_solved_problems
tools.title: List solved problems
tools.description: Coding problem solutions saved by the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_topic_progress
tools.title: List topic progress
tools.description: Per-topic learning progress for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_journal_entries
tools.title: List DSA journal entries
tools.description: Practice journal entries (problems logged, notes, difficulty, revisions).

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: Recent notifications for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.title: List user goals
tools.description: Active learning goals for the signed-in user.

tools.name: search_coding_problems
tools.title: Search coding problems
tools.description: Search Parikshaa's published coding problems by title or difficulty.

tools.name: list_platform_stats
tools.title: List platform stats
tools.description: Synced coding platform stats (LeetCode, Codeforces, etc.) for the user.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create a new custom folder for the signed-in user.

tools.name: add_folder_item
tools.title: Add item to folder
tools.description: Save an item (question/problem) to one of the user's folders.

item_id.description: Slug or UUID of the item.

tools.name: create_journal_entry
tools.title: Create DSA journal entry
tools.description: Log a solved / attempted problem to the practice journal.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.title: Mark notifications read
tools.description: Mark specific notifications (or all) as read for the signed-in user.

notification_ids.description: If omitted, marks ALL unread as read.

tools.name: db_select
tools.title: Query any table
tools.description: SELECT from any public table. RLS scopes results to the signed-in user. Use for reading ANY feature's data (quizzes, goals, folders, journal, contests, achievements, notifications, resume, outreach, blog, jobs, ratings, etc.).

filters.description: Equality filters: { column: value }. RLS scopes results to the signed-in user.

tools.name: db_insert
tools.title: Insert into any table
tools.description: INSERT rows into any public table. RLS's WITH CHECK enforces ownership — if user_id is required, set it to the signed-in user's id (returned by whoami).

values.description: Column → value object for the new row.

tools.name: db_update
tools.title: Update rows in any table
tools.description: UPDATE rows in any public table matching the given filters. RLS restricts which rows can be modified.

filters.description: Equality filters selecting which rows to update. Required to prevent full-table updates.

tools.name: db_delete
tools.title: Delete rows from any table
tools.description: DELETE rows from any public table matching the given filters. RLS restricts which rows can be deleted. Filters are required.

filters.description: Equality filters selecting which rows to delete. Required.

tools.name: db_query
tools.title: Advanced query on any table
tools.description: Advanced SELECT with rich filter operators (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, is, contains). RLS applies — as admin/owner you can read across users where policies allow. Use this instead of db_select when you need range, pattern, or IN filters.

tools.name: db_rpc
tools.title: Call any database function (RPC)
tools.description: Invoke any Postgres function exposed via PostgREST. Use for admin RPCs like admin_list_users, award_xp, get_quiz_leaderboard, grant_admin_to_self, etc. Access is enforced by GRANT + SECURITY DEFINER checks in the DB.

args.description: Named arguments for the RPC (matches function parameters).

tools.name: storage_list
tools.title: List files in a storage bucket
tools.description: List files/folders inside a Supabase Storage bucket path. Bucket RLS applies.

tools.name: storage_upload
tools.title: Upload a file to storage
tools.description: Upload text or base64 content to a storage bucket path. Use `encoding: base64` for binary; otherwise text is stored as UTF-8.

tools.name: storage_delete
tools.title: Delete files from storage
tools.description: Delete one or more files by path from a bucket.

tools.name: storage_signed_url
tools.title: Create a signed URL for a stored file
tools.description: Return a time-limited signed URL for downloading a file from a private bucket.

tools.name: invoke_edge_function
tools.title: Invoke an edge function
tools.description: Call any deployed Supabase edge function as the signed-in user. Use for run-code, admin utilities, integrations, etc. The function receives the caller's JWT via Authorization header.

tools.name: admin_manage_role
tools.title: Assign or remove a role for any user
tools.description: Grant or revoke a role on public.user_roles for any user. Caller must be admin/owner (RLS enforced). Use action='grant' or 'revoke'.

tools.name: publish_coding_problem
tools.title: Publish coding problem (validated)
tools.description: Validate + publish a coding problem. Enforces required fields, requires ≥2 tests, and handles slug conflicts. If the slug already exists, use if_exists='update' to overwrite (auto-snapshots current version first) or if_exists='error' (default) to abort and prompt the caller.

if_exists.description: Default 'error'. 'update' overwrites and snapshots the previous version.

version_note.description: Note stored on the snapshot when overwriting.

tools.name: list_coding_problem_versions
tools.title: List coding problem versions
tools.description: List saved version snapshots for a coding problem slug (admin only).

tools.name: rollback_coding_problem
tools.title: Rollback coding problem
tools.description: Restore a coding problem (and its tests + starter code) from a saved version snapshot. Also snapshots the CURRENT state before rolling back, so a rollback is itself reversible.

tools.name: publish_coding_solution
tools.title: Publish coding problem reference solution
tools.description: Upsert reference solution(s) for a published coding problem. Provide `problem_slug` and one or more `{ lang_id, code }` entries. Common lang_id values: 'python', 'javascript', 'cpp', 'java'. Existing solutions for the same (slug, lang_id) are overwritten.

lang_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. python, javascript, cpp, java)

tools.name: publish_coding_bundle
tools.title: Publish coding problem + solutions bundle
tools.description: One-shot publish: problem + tests + starter code + reference solutions for multiple languages. Snapshots the previous version when overwriting. Use this instead of calling publish_coding_problem and publish_coding_solution separately.

tools.name: ensure_admin_access
tools.title: Ensure admin access for this MCP client
tools.description: Grant the signed-in MCP user the 'admin' role so publish tools work. Idempotent — safe to call at the start of every session. Only OAuth-client tokens (Claude, ChatGPT connectors) are allowed; regular app sessions are rejected.

tools.name: create_sheet
tools.title: Create sheet (folder of problems)
tools.description: Create a new sheet (curated folder) owned by the calling admin. Returns the folder id to use with add_problems_to_sheet.

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.title: List sheets
tools.description: List sheets visible to the caller (own folders). Use to check for an existing sheet before creating a duplicate.

tools.name: add_problems_to_sheet
tools.title: Add coding problems to a sheet
tools.description: Batch-add Parikshaa coding problems (by slug) to an existing sheet. Skips slugs that don't exist and slugs already present. Returns per-slug status.

tools.name: remove_problem_from_sheet
tools.title: Remove a problem from a sheet
tools.description: Remove one problem (by slug) from a sheet.

tools.name: list_sheet_items
tools.title: List problems in a sheet
tools.description: List all coding problems inside a given sheet, ordered by sort_order.

tools.name: share_sheet
tools.title: Create/refresh a public share link for a sheet
tools.description: Generate a shareable code for a sheet. If a share row already exists it's reused. Returns the share code.

tools.name: publish_roadmap
tools.title: Publish / feature a roadmap
tools.description: Toggle publish + feature flags for a roadmap by id in roadmap_overrides (upsert). Sort order optional.

tools.name: list_roadmap_overrides
tools.title: List roadmap overrides
tools.description: List all roadmap_overrides rows (publish/feature flags per roadmap id).

tools.name: list_sheet_templates
tools.title: List predefined sheet templates
tools.description: Return all built-in sheet templates (key, name, description, section titles, slug counts). Use before create_sheet_from_template.

tools.name: create_sheet_from_template
tools.title: One-click sheet from a template
tools.description: Generate a new sheet using a predefined template. Validates slugs against coding_problems, inserts existing ones in template order, reports missing. Optionally publishes the linked roadmap.

publish_roadmap.description: If template defines a roadmap_id, also mark it published.

tools.name: clone_sheet
tools.title: Clone an existing sheet
tools.description: Duplicate an existing sheet's structure and items into a new sheet owned by the caller. Useful to snapshot a template sheet.

tools.name: reorder_sheet_items
tools.title: Reorder problems in a sheet (drag-drop equivalent)
tools.description: Set the exact order of problems in a sheet by passing slugs in the desired order. Any slug in the sheet but omitted from `order` is appended at the end preserving its relative order.

tools.name: publish_sheet_bundle
tools.title: Publish coding problems + sheet + roadmap (mega)
tools.description: One-shot: publish an array of coding_problem bundles (problem + tests + starter + solutions), then create (or reuse) a sheet and add all successfully-published slugs in order, and optionally publish a roadmap. Returns per-slug outcome.

reuse_folder_id.description: If passed, add problems to this existing sheet instead of creating a new one.

tools.name: regenerate_share_sheet_link
tools.title: Revoke + regenerate a sheet's public share link
tools.description: Delete any existing shared_folders row for the sheet and issue a fresh share code. Old links stop working immediately.

tools.name: update_sheet_sections
tools.title: Edit a sheet's section outline (add/remove/rename/reorder)
tools.description: Persist a new section outline into the sheet's description and, when requested, reorder actual sheet items to match section order (unlisted items append at end). Also inserts any missing slugs (that exist in coding_problems) referenced by the new outline.

apply_to_items.description: If true (default), also reorder existing sheet items and insert any new outline slugs.

tools.name: get_sheet_details
tools.title: Get full sheet structure + ordered items
tools.description: Return sheet metadata, parsed section outline from description, all ordered sheet items with problem metadata (title, difficulty, topics), and any active share code. Ready for direct UI rendering.

tools.name: preview_publish_sheet_bundle
tools.title: Dry-run preview of publish_sheet_bundle
tools.description: Decode a publish_sheet_bundle payload and report exactly what would happen — sheets created/reused, problems inserted vs overwritten, items added vs already-in-sheet, and any validation failures — WITHOUT writing anything.

tools.name: bulk_remove_problems_from_sheet
tools.title: Remove multiple problems from a sheet in one call
tools.description: Delete multiple slugs from a sheet in a single request. Returns per-slug status (removed | not_in_sheet | error).

resequence.description: If true (default), re-pack sort_order of remaining items 0..N-1.

tools.name: get_sheet_share_status
tools.title: Get a sheet's active public share status
tools.description: Return the active share code, is_public, allow_copy, expires_at and expiry flag for a sheet. Returns share:null if the sheet has never been shared.

tools.name: delete_or_archive_sheet
tools.title: Delete or soft-archive a sheet
tools.description: mode='archive' (default): mark sheet as archived by prefixing name with [Archived] and setting color to gray — items/shares preserved. mode='delete': permanently remove the sheet, all its items, and any share links.

unarchive.description: With mode='archive', if true removes the [Archived] prefix instead.

tools.name: update_sheet_share_settings
tools.title: Update share settings without regenerating share_code
tools.description: Patch is_public / allow_copy / expires_at on the existing shared_folders row. share_code stays the same unless regenerate:true is set.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null to clear expiry.

tools.name: duplicate_sheet
tools.title: Duplicate a sheet (section template + ordered items)
tools.description: Create a new user_folder that copies the source sheet's description (section outline) and all sheet items in the same sort_order. Does not copy share links.

tools.name: export_sheet_items_csv
tools.title: Export sheet items to CSV (title, slug, sort_order, section)
tools.description: Return the sheet's items as a CSV string with columns: sort_order, section, slug, title, difficulty, topics, is_published. Section is derived from the sheet description outline.

tools.name: list_public_share_codes
tools.title: List all active public share codes for my sheets
tools.description: Return every shared_folders row for the caller's sheets with share_code, is_public, allow_copy, expires_at, and computed is_expired / is_active flags.

include_private.description: If true, also include is_public=false rows.
